nodes.description: Public constant bytes32 role MANAGER_ROLE = keccak256("MANAGER_ROLE"), the only authorized caller of withdraw().
Mapping of token balances; mutated on every transfer, mint and burn. Holds the 3,000,000 ether supply minted to the contract itself.
Total token supply of DinoEggs, increased by _mint during construction and decreased by _burn.
Nested mapping of spender allowances, updated by _approve/transferFrom/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance.
Mapping(bytes32 => RoleData) storing role members and each role's admin role; written by _grantRole/_revokeRole/_setRoleAdmin.
Deploys the ERC20 with name 'DinoEggs'/'$DinoEggs', mints 3000000 ether to the contract address itself and grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to the deployer.
External function guarded by onlyRole(MANAGER_ROLE); checks _amount <= balanceOf(address(this)) then transfers tokens out of the contract to _address.
Internal transfer routine: validates sender/recipient, invokes _beforeTokenTransfer/_afterTokenTransfer hooks, updates _balances and emits Transfer.
Internal mint routine: increments _totalSupply and _balances[account] and emits Transfer from the zero address.
Internal unrestricted role granting: sets _roles[role].members[account] = true and emits RoleGranted with _msgSender() as sender.
Caller-controlled address returned by _msgSender(); used for the withdraw access-control gate and for the RoleGranted event in the constructor.
Token transfer performed inside withdraw via _transfer(address(this), _address, _amount); moves contract-held tokens to a caller-supplied address and runs overridable transfer hooks.
Initial supply creation via _mint(address(this), 3000000 ether) executed in the constructor.
Privilege assignment via _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, _msgSender()) executed in the constructor, making the deployer the admin.
Destination address parameter of DinoEggs.withdraw, fully controlled by the MANAGER_ROLE caller.
Amount of tokens to withdraw; bounded by the balanceOf(address(this)) require check.
Source address of the internal _transfer call (address(this) when reached through withdraw).
Destination address of the internal _transfer call.
Amount moved by the internal _transfer call.
Local cache of _balances[sender] used to validate and decrement the sender balance inside _transfer.

edges.reason: The DinoEggs constructor executes the initial _mint call.
The DinoEggs constructor executes the _grantRole call for DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
_grantRole is invoked with _msgSender() in the constructor, binding the initial admin privilege to the deployer-supplied caller identity.
_grantRole writes _roles[role].members[account] = true, mutating the access-control state of the contract.
_mint increments _totalSupply by amount; supply accounting depends on this unchecked-value-adjacent arithmetic.
_mint credits the newly created tokens to _balances[account].
msg.sender is consumed by the onlyRole(MANAGER_ROLE) modifier (_checkRole -> _msgSender) that gates withdraw.
MANAGER_ROLE is the required role checked before withdraw body execution.
withdraw forwards its _address parameter to the token transfer destination.
withdraw passes its _amount parameter into the balance check and transfer.
withdraw executes the internal token transfer instruction.
The caller-supplied _address becomes the recipient of the withdraw transfer.
The caller-supplied _amount determines how many tokens are moved by the withdraw transfer.
The withdraw transfer delegates to ERC20._transfer, which also runs the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer/_afterTokenTransfer hooks.
The withdraw transfer debits the contract's own _balances entry and credits the recipient balance.
The token transfer (and its virtual transfer hooks) is an external-call surface reachable from withdraw before state finalization, allowing re-entry into withdraw.
_transfer receives the sender argument and reads _balances[sender].
_transfer receives the recipient argument and credits _balances[recipient].
_transfer receives the amount argument used for the balance check and mutations.
_transfer initializes the local senderBalance from the on-chain balance.
senderBalance is a cached read of _balances[sender] before the decrement.
_transfer writes the updated sender and recipient balances back into _balances.

normalization_plan.reason: The destination parameter only exists to feed the single unsafe token transfer inside withdraw.
The amount parameter only exists to size the unsafe token transfer performed by withdraw.
The sender parameter is a transient argument of the internal _transfer routine and can be folded into it.
The recipient parameter is a transient argument of the internal _transfer routine and can be folded into it.
The amount parameter is a transient argument of the internal _transfer routine and can be folded into it.
The senderBalance local only exists for the duration of the _transfer balance update and can be absorbed by that function.
